List – II (Example)

(III) Dover

detailedSolution:
Detailed Solution:

(B) Packet Stations (Ferry Ports): These are concerned with the transportation of passengers and mail across short water bodies (e.g., Dover in England and Calais in France) (III). (C) Entrepot Ports: These are collection centres where the goods are brought from different countries for export (e.g., Rotterdam, Singapore) (II). (D) Naval Ports: Ports serving warships and defence establishments (e.g., Kochi and Karwar in India) (IV). Matching: (A)-(I), (B)-(III), (C)-(II), (D)-(IV).
Hence, option (C) is the correct match.

(B) Areal Differentiation

Hence, option (D) is correct.
